Useful against enemies with electrical attacks.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can drink Electro Elixirs to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. They're known to be useful against electrical attacks. Before parting at [[Inogo Bridge]], [[Sidon]] will gift Link an Electro Elixir to show his faith in him.{{Cite|Oh! That's right! I have something that I would like to give to you! This is just a small trinket to show that I have faith in you.|Sidon|BotW}} He notes that they have no effect on [[Zora]], which he theorizes is due to them being made for [[Hylian]]s.{{Cite|I am not sure why, but its effects do not seem to work for Zora. Perhaps because it was made specifically for Hylians.|Sidon|BotW}} Electro Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Electric Darner]] * [[Thunderwing Butterfly]] By adding any of these electric ingredients, Link can make an Electro Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Voltfruit]] * [[Zapshroom]] * [[Electric Safflina]] * [[Voltfin Trout]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
